events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher, known as the frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the iconic frontman?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released in the US on September 9, 1971, and in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine the Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. What does this timeless anthem mean to you?

events.title: Apple's first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, and it became available for purchase on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Music
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago, it put 1,000 songs in your pocket and changed music forever. What was the first album you loaded on yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Imagine His Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Ministry of Silly Walks
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Revolutionary White Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. A double LP that pushed boundaries and delivered classics. What's your standout track?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a pivotal shift in their sound. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: A Day of Remembrance
angles.copy: On this day, 46 years ago, we lost a musical visionary. Remembering John Lennon and his enduring message of peace and love.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie, the influential English singer, songwriter, and actor, was born on January 8, 1947.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today. His artistry continues to inspire.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', was born on January 8, 1935, in Tupelo, Mississippi.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. What's your favourite track from The King?
